name: btc_market
description: Read public Binance USD-M futures market data (no API key): 24h ticker, klines/OHLCV, funding rate, open interest and long/short ratio for a symbol such as BTCUSDT. Returns JSON with derived window stats (high/low/change) for analysis. Read-only: never places orders.

symbol.description: Binance USDT-M futures symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT

interval.description: Kline interval; long/short uses 5m for 1m, 6h for 8h, and 1d for 1w, reported as long_short.period. long_pct/short_pct are percentages (0..100).
